a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first means we're both very likely dead after round 1. Only one of us can be covered right now, so I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If we get past the storm, I'll operate every round after that so we can rebuild the reserve for you. I won't take any more than 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks our plan. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.
Operating now and every round after. Once the reserve has 4, it's all yours. I won't touch it.
